problem.title: Painting Classes Turrialba: Art Therapy and coffee for your well-being
problem.desc: Looking for a different activity in Turrialba to relax, disconnect from stress and dedicate quality time to yourself?
problem.instagram: If you commented the word ARTETERAPIA on our Instagram, you've come to the right place.
problem.p1: We live in an age where stress, worries and mental overload are part of the daily routine. Many people in Turrialba look for activities to reduce stress and get out of the routine.
problem.p2: At Mj Estética and Wellness Center we have created a unique experience that combines art therapy, resin bear painting and coffee, designed to help you release tension, stimulate your creativity and improve your emotional well-being in a cozy and safe environment.

whatIs.title: What is Art Therapy?
whatIs.desc: Art therapy is a wellness technique that uses the creative process as a tool to express emotions, reduce stress and improve emotional health.
points: It doesn't matter if you've never picked up a brush.
We aren't looking for artists here. We seek to help you feel better.

cards.d: Painting helps focus attention on the present, reducing repetitive thoughts.
Art allows you to express emotions naturally and safely in a cozy environment.
Develop new ideas and strengthen your problem-solving ability.

who.title: Who Can Participate?
who.desc: Our Art Therapy experience in Turrialba is ideal for anyone who wants to relax and enjoy a moment for themselves.

includes.title: What Does Your Experience Include?
items: Guidance and support during the session
Your finished work to take home
includes.quote: There are no strict rules. There is no pressure. There is only the present moment.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Mj Estética and Wellness Center?
whyUs.desc: At Mj Estética and Wellness Center we understand that well-being goes far beyond aesthetics. We believe that feeling good inside is also reflected on the outside.

testimonials.title: Discovering Well-being
items: I arrived saying 'I don't know how to paint' and ended up discovering that the important thing was how I felt. I left much calmer.
A different way to connect with myself. Delicious coffee and the environment is simply magical.
It helped me let go of the stress of the week. You don't need to be an artist, you just need to want to feel good.

items.q: Do I need to know how to paint?
items.a: No. We aren't looking for artists, we seek to help you feel better. The experience is designed so that anyone can enjoy it regardless of their artistic level.
It includes all painting materials, a delicious cup of coffee (or alternative drink), guidance during the activity and an environment designed for relaxation.
It is ideal for people with work stress, couples, groups of friends or anyone who wants to dedicate time to their emotional well-being and get out of the routine.
At Mj Estética and Wellness Center, in downtown Turrialba, with parking available.
